rightsObserved.statement: The conversion README states that CMU places no use restrictions and the converter adds none, including research and commercial use.

rig.format: BVH hierarchy with declared channel order Zrotation Yrotation Xrotation

analysis.method: 3D forward kinematics through complete hierarchy; geometric knee angle between femur and shank; side-view plane uses root travel direction and world vertical.

normalization.method: Vertical extent all joints/end sites of added frame 0 T-pose; source units unestablished, not metres

visualizationCycleEstimate.scope: For plotting only; no clinical cadence or exact phase registration.

C160-PLAYER.units: world pixels and normalized skeleton lengths, not metres
capturePairs: Neutral left/right next to the same human NPC and floor.
At least one full slow walking cycle left/right, running cycle, brake and restart.
Crouch idle/move, jump ascent/apex/landing, ladder step and vent entry/exit.
Same camera zoom, viewport, outfit, neutral pose and known Save-picker fixture before/after.
metrics: Silhouette alpha height/width and skull/waist/hip/floor landmarks.
Distance between registered belt and pelvis centres; same single anatomical frame in both facings.
Femur/shank world length constant across all poses; triangle reach remains feasible.
Support-foot drift, knee bending direction, pelvis/torso continuity and clearance during swing.
Frame-to-frame displacement/angle continuity, plus pause/read-only draw idempotence.
passConditions: No detached waist, reversed knee, below-floor sole or visibly rescaled leg across postures.
Numeric constraints are engineering plausibility checks; external anatomical 1:1 remains unapproved.

capturePairs: Empty scan, one moving front contact, same actor stopped, rear/side movement and multiple actors.
Left/right facing, changing deck/room, active cinematic/pause and resume.
Tracker absent/unselected and no hidden actor ID/species labels.
metrics: Screen centre and direction map to the player pose in the active coordinate chart.
Range and distance use explicitly named game units; radar radius boundary matches the actual filter.
Contacts require measured actor movement; user movement alone cannot animate a stationary entity.
Scan refresh and beep schedule advance by simulation time and hold during pause.
passConditions: UI compared to official Isolation illustration as an attributed adaptation, not a faithful M314 recreation.
No wall-occlusion or deck omniscience claimed as movie canon.

capturePairs: Primary/sidearm/heavy or launcher in both facings.
Eight aim directions, muzzle shot onset, recoil recovery and reload stages.
Crouching, moving, aiming backwards and tracker/tool swap.
metrics: Grip/hand and stock/shoulder anchor residuals after their actual shared matrices.
Rendered barrel axis intersects actual projectile origin/velocity, with no backwards muzzle flash.
No arm IK beyond reachable length; bone lengths invariant after tool/weapon swaps.
Local silhouette ratios compared only with an identified corresponding model source.
passConditions: No firearm-size claim from mixed-source image grids.
Unpictured M41A or other models retain source gaps.

capturePairs: Same sequence after Save reload, reduced-motion, skip and failure.
metrics: Scene geography and character blocking agree with the following playable room.
Choice text, actual persisted consequence and return dialogue refer to the same event.
Skip/replay cannot duplicate rewards or skip required gameplay state.
Camera/text fit same viewport and remain usable in small-screen layouts.
passConditions: Original Tantalus story is labelled as project fiction; film synopsis is context only.
Promotional framing is inspiration, not proof of exact cinematic duration or a canonical scene.
